gate_results.scope: success with closed valid record identical to actual local committed-source classification

scope_output: one compact JSON string in fixed GITHUB_OUTPUT key record; every relied-upon value type checked, no shell/code interpolation

sidecar_closed_fields.ref: actual fixed runner ref joined to source event
sidecar_closed_fields.workflow_ref: actual runner workflow reference, literal root workflow path and expected caller ref
sidecar_closed_fields.workflow_sha: actual runner workflow definition commit SHA1; verify every executed workflow-definition blob matches its checkout counterpart rather than guessing it always equals checkout SHA
sidecar_closed_fields.classification: closed exact ci-scope.v1 output, revalidated against local actual event and checkout
sidecar_closed_fields.logical_results: closed mapping of exact18needs roots to original result values, not relabeled success for skipped
sidecar_closed_fields.source_map_sha256: SHA256 of UTF8 ensure_ascii=true sort_keys=true separators=(comma,colon) JSON encoding of exact source_map object, with no LF
sidecar_closed_fields.declared_external_boundaries: existing GitHub Actions/runtime refs, interpreter and package/native dependency qualification remain baseline boundaries; no fullhost/physical or sourcebinaryplatform-attestation claim
sidecar_closed_fields.gate_qualified: boolean procedure outcome; false does not establish source or package qualification
sidecar_closed_fields.source_map: all tracked canonical Git blob paths with type/mode/GitOID/byte length/SHA256, complete tree inventory; unknown nonregular/nonUTF8 entries invalidate this version

source_producer: rootcheck tools/ci_provenance.py imports only reviewed ci_gate/ci_scope and stdlib; Git reads declared immutable checkout, complete ls-tree and batch blob stream; fixed output dist/ci/policy/qualification.json, untracked generated output excluded from source tree
working_source_binding: new executed root tool bytes must match declared Git blobs; no mutable source lookup replaces immutable identities
external_final_join: after workflow completion an independent collector binds registered literal root path/ID, API run head/event/attempt, actual PR merge parents/tree or push source, final check and exact callee OS job/step IDs/outcomes, sidecar blob map and current leaf artifacts/digests/expiry to existing package verification/source/archive/installed proof
not_self_attestation: sidecar records gate evaluation before final run completes; it cannot attest its own final completion, artifact receipt, physical cleanup or complete GitHub platform implementation
legacy_preserved: quickstart pinned accepted foundation run/workflow/job/main contract
manual evaluation workflow_dispatch study_id and qualify/study predicates; no new study execution
all old leaf matrix/permissions/fail-fast/build and validation operations; normal upload names explicitly versioned for exact attempts
historical accepted artifact names/IDs and pinned quickstart readers; manual evaluation upload unchanged
actual_API_presentation: observed and separately validated during current test runs, not guessed wildcards or synthetic PASS
cost_limits: FULL adds scope and aggregate jobs; routine continuity changes stay FULL. Only admitted reader-only edits benefit. No claim that ordinary multi-document release stories become cheap; no invented speedup threshold.

source_map_entry_closed_fields.sha256: 64lowerhex SHA256 of exact Git blob bytes

source_map_path_rules: every tracked canonical Git blob exactly once from complete ls-tree -r -z --full-tree; strict UTF8 relative POSIX path, no empty/absolute/dotdot component. Gitlinks, symlinks, unknown modes or missing/bad batch objects reject this version. This is new project-owned routing-source closure, not a full OS/Actions/native-platform attestation.

artifact_contract.uploader: actions/upload-artifact@v4, fixed declared ref matching existing pipeline action boundary

failure_schema.run_id: positive integer or null if invalid
failure_schema.run_attempt: positive integer or null if invalid

artifact_contract.failure_behavior: nonzero root producer/gate exit; failure JSON only into fresh fixed output if available. Missing artifact/upload failure cannot pass. Never reuse another attempt or another run artifact.

attempt_binding.accepted: positive complete whole workflow attempts with every required actual job from exact attempts/N/jobs API, never reused success from a prior attempt
attempt_binding.new_normal_leaf_name: preserve legacy prefix/CHECKOUT_SHA/[EVENT]/OS and append -attempt-ATTEMPT, an explicit versioned current-CI contract change; old accepted artifact IDs/bindings untouched
attempt_binding.manual_evaluation: preserve original workflow_dispatch name/upload behavior and study input/event predicates; separate normal-event upload step uses attempt suffix, no study executed
attempt_binding.artifact_join: query exact run ID only; exact versioned name includes attempt and checkout; require expected source,event,OS and immutable artifact IDs/digests/expiry. No repository-global name matching. Require complete job inventory at actual same attempt; re-run-failed-only partial attempts cannot qualify full package forms. Older attempts remain preserved failed/diagnostic records, never relabeled.

needs_value_schema.result: success/failure/cancelled/skipped string; only accepted combinations in gate_results

scope_outputs.record: compact JSON string, closed strict ci-scope.v1, identical to actual recomputed classification

needs_value_schema.other_outputs: empty object; extra outputs reject this version
needs_value_schema.JSON: reject duplicate keys and nonstandard constants; exact types exclude bool-as-int
